STAGE: design selection
GOAL: pick one in-scope mechanism that is distinct from the four previously rejected probes and from the four other ideation agents.
READ: the round objective, the scope contract, and the failure record of rounds 20261028/20261029 (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID).
OBSERVED: the previous round's certificate was necessary but not sufficient and moved ~1/3 of the catalogue; every rejected probe either (a) edits the codebook during Stage-2 training with successor-weighting, (b) sets curvature per level or per item radius from behaviour entropy, or (c) smooths successor profiles. None of them bounds the move set by a statistical confusion test on the frozen Stage-3 prefix context.
REASONING: the free design space left on the requested chain is the ADMISSION TEST on the move itself. Candidate built: a post-Stage-2, level-L-only (levels 1..L-1 bit-identical) split/merge with (i) a Gromov-delta cut certificate on a successor-barycentre Poincare metric, and (ii) a NEW precision filter that only admits moves touching a critical-confusion pair, where criticality is a one-Poisson-sigma band on the training-split top-2 deepest-code counts plus a geodesic-nearest-competitor condition. No tuned constants: sigma=1, derived radii, derived cross-mass bound.
OPEN: write the full labelled answer block, check the cost arithmetic at 24556 items / 24 steps / 3000 epochs.

STAGE: cost and safeguard arithmetic
GOAL: verify the frozen-scale cost claim for the one-off deepest-level edit.
READ: frozen budget given in the prompt (24556 training items, 24 steps per epoch, 3000 Stage-2 epochs, 150 Stage-3 epochs).
OBSERVED: Stage-2 and Stage-3 per-step added FLOPs are exactly zero because the edit is a post-Stage-2 relabelling of the deepest code only; Stage 3 consumes the edited SID table unchanged in shape. The edit itself needs at most 3 rounds over the successor set of critical prefixes; upper bound ~24556 successor tokens/round, ~7M Poincare distance evaluations total.
REASONING: 7e6 geodesic evals amortised over 72000 Stage-2 steps is ~97 evals per step equivalent, negligible against an RQ-VAE step on four cards. Wall clock addition is minutes against hours.
OPEN: none; numbers transferred into the COST field.

STAGE: final answer delivered (idea gromovcrit-deepest-split)
GOAL: hand over the complete, in-scope proposal.
READ: nothing new; consolidated the two earlier records.
OBSERVED: the candidate is a post-Stage-2, level-L-only SID edit. Training-only directed transitions give popularity-adjusted successor Poincare barycentres b_i; prefix behaviour centroids give a confusion table N(p,k1),N(p,k2) on deepest codes; a prefix is CRITICAL iff the top-two counts differ by at most one Poisson sigma sqrt(N(p,k1)) AND the competitor is the geodesically nearest competing frozen centroid; only successor items of critical prefixes form the surgical target set S*; a geodesic two-means on S* proposes a split of k1 into k1',k1''; the split is written only if the Gromov-delta cut certificate holds on the split side (scale-relative separation, defect reduction of at least half, cross-mass below the within-median), the merge side is admitted only for non-critical overlapping codes, AND the Poincare margin widens for every triggering prefix, d_P(b_bar_p,m'')-d_P(b_bar_p,m') > d_P(b_bar_p,c_k2)-d_P(b_bar_p,c_k1). Levels 1..L-1 asserted bit-identical. Mandatory reports: moved fraction, validation L1 negative hit rate before/after, per-item deepest-code conditional entropy before/after. No tuned constants (sigma=1, medians, 3 documented rounds). One training run, switches exist but no ablation arm is trained, no sweep, no multi-seed.
REASONING: it occupies the admission-test position on the requested chain, which none of the rejected probes did, and the extra condition is derived from training counts plus frozen Stage-2 geometry, answering the earlier round's one-third-catalogue failure.
COST: 0 added per-step FLOPs in Stage 2 and Stage 3; one-off ~3e6 geodesic evals, ~97 amortised per frozen step, under 1 percent wall clock.
OPEN: none; the answer block is the deliverable.
